block.tconstruct.steel_cluster.tooltip: Natural formation of steel shards. Does not regrow.

block.tconstruct.cobalt_cluster.tooltip: Natural formation of cobalt shards. Does not regrow.

item.tconstruct.creative_slot.only: Creative slots only work for players in creative.
item.tconstruct.arrow_cast.tooltip: Reusable pattern for making arrow parts in the part builder
fluid.tconstruct.blazing_blood.fluid_eff: Blazing blood is an acceptable fluid for combat, but it really shines as a light source.
fluid.tconstruct.powdered_snow.fluid_eff: Powder snow is a useful fluid for nether combat, dealing bonus damage to blazing mobs.
fluid.tconstruct.honey.fluid_effect: So sweet, and removes toxins, what not to love with slurping honey?
fluid.tconstruct.beetroot_soup.fluid_eff: Beetroot soup is an easily farmable slurpable food option.
fluid.tconstruct.mushroom_stew.fluid_eff: Mushroom stew is a very affordable soup option for slurping on the go.
fluid.tconstruct.rabbit_stew.fluid_effec: Rabbit stew is the best liquid food available, ideal for slurping.
fluid.tconstruct.meat_soup.fluid_effect: Don't ask what is in the meat soup; just enjoy the flavor as you slurp this down.
fluid.tconstruct.potion.fluid_effect: Potions allow a wide variety of effects crafted in a brewing stand. Can dump potions into tanks to fill tools.
fluid.tconstruct.earth_slime.fluid_effec: Earthslime is a portable piston, ideal for simple flying carpets. Well, assuming bricks count as carpet.
fluid.tconstruct.sky_slime.fluid_effect: Skyslime is a portable piston, ideal for when you built your base just 1 block away from where it belongs.
fluid.tconstruct.venom.fluid_effect: Venom pairs very well with venombone, the hint is in the name.
fluid.tconstruct.ichor.fluid_effect: Ichor is a reverse gravity fluid, helping you also reverse gravity. Surviving the trip back down is on you.
fluid.tconstruct.seared_stone.fluid_effe: Most unusual method of smeltery construction.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_clay.fluid_effec: Great for quickly building a wall, or just solidifying clay without a cast.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_glass.fluid_effe: Molten glass can quickly solidify into an easily removable window.
fluid.tconstruct.liquid_soul.fluid_effec: Liquid soul lets you greatly slow opponents, at least that is the hope.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_obsidian.fluid_e: Molten obsidian becomes a very difficult to remove blockage.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_emerald.fluid_ef: Molten emerald is the choice for mining when you need silk touch.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_quartz.fluid_eff: Molten quartz is a modest mining fluid, not too expensive and not too strong.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_amethyst.fluid_e: Molten amethyst is the cheapest mining fluid, but its not very strong.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_diamond.fluid_ef: Molten diamond lets you maximize the drops of your ores, but is it worth the cost of the fluid?
fluid.tconstruct.molten_ender.fluid_effe: Placing blocks turns a slimestaff into a building wand.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_iron.fluid_effec: Molten iron is used to draw nearby items towards you, though in a pinch it can be useful in combat.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_gold.fluid_effec: Molten gold first hurts you, then it heals you back more. Is it worth it? Up to you.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_copper.fluid_eff: Molten copper is a good emergency air supply for long underwater journeys.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_cobalt.fluid_eff: Inhaling the lingering cloud is the safest way to use molten cobalt for haste, or just use it as a weapon.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_debris.fluid_eff: Molten debris is the strongest fluid for mining, even capable of mining obsidian.
Sometimes you really want to fight some phantoms, drinking a lot of molten amethyst bronze can help that happen.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_rose_gold.fluid_: Molten rose gold lets you lose a small amount of health for a temporary edge.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_pig_iron.fluid_e: Molten pig iron is the tastiest of molten metals. Not that its much of a competition.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_manyullyn.fluid_: Molten manyullyn has the most damage potential between flat damage and damage over time.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_hepatizon.fluid_: Cold is a rare damage source, but can be neutralized by warm clothes. The withering may help in that case.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_knightmetal.flui: Ironically, Knightmetal is most suited to killing those from who it comes.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_netherite.fluid_: Molten netherite is the highest base damage, for when you cannot wait for your target to bleed out.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_tin.fluid_effect: They say carrots are good for your eyes, but molten tin is better.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_aluminum.fluid_e: Molten aluminium is like milk, but aggressive. Ideal for combat when your opponents have too many effects.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_lead.fluid_effec: Molten lead gives your attacks a little extra boost, if you are willing to wait.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_silver.fluid_eff: Molten silver removes toxins without removing helpful effects.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_nickel.fluid_eff: Molten nickel lets you harm your enemies and reduce the risk of retaliation, what's not to love?
fluid.tconstruct.molten_zinc.fluid_effec: Molten zinc is probably not the best choice to boost your speed, perhaps the speed will throw off an opponent.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_platinum.fluid_e: Not sure the applications of molten platinum slowing your enemies' mining speed, but you can probably figure one out.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_tungsten.fluid_e: Molten tungsten is one of the heaviest metals, hopefully it will keep your enemies still.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_osmium.fluid_eff: Molten osmium keeps your enemies still for a future blow.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_uranium.fluid_ef: Radioactive decay from molten uranium isn't safe to be around, so dump it on your enemies.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_chromium.fluid_e: If only luck was actually a useful effect, this fluid would be great to drink!
fluid.tconstruct.molten_bronze.fluid_eff: Molten bronze is the perfect dark brown beverage for when you need to stay away and stave off phantoms.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_brass.fluid_effe: Molten brass helps you resist the heat, and the second sip is free if you time it right.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_electrum.fluid_e: Molten electrum is great for when you need to mine fast on a budget.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_invar.fluid_effe: Molten invar may be useful if you are trying to eat that powerful cake, but otherwise is an odd fluid.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_constantan.fluid: Molten constantan is useful against human opponents perhaps, but not so much against monsters.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_pewter.fluid_eff: Molten pewter is probably lower risk than venom to boost your strength, but not by much.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_steel.fluid_effe: Molten steel lets you clear out enemies around you, or spread out bunched up enemies.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_enderium.fluid_e: Molten enderium is ideal as a weapon, keeping enemies from teleporting as you fight.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_lumium.fluid_eff: Molten lumium is either used to keep your eye on the target or make a quick but obvious escape.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_refined_glowston: Molten refined glowstone is great for tracking targets without sacrificing much damage.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_refined_obsidian: Molten refined obsidian maximizes damage against armored targets.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_nicrosil.fluid_e: Nicrosil has an innate pull on magic, seems like a waste to use it like this.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_bendalloy.fluid_: A perfect snack for the middle of a battle.
fluid.tconstruct.molten_steeleaf.fluid_e: Useful both for you and your target to maximize gained experience.
fluid.tconstruct.fiery_liquid.fluid_effe: You might think this is a fantastic deal, so many extra ingots! But remember, fiery is really hard to get.
fluid_effect.tconstruct.potion: Applies effects from potion, scaled by level
fluid_effect.tconstruct.push_entity.push: Pushes target with distance based on level
fluid_effect.tconstruct.push_entity.pull: Pulls target with distance based on level
fluid_effect.tconstruct.break_block.hard: Mines up to hardness %s per level
fluid_effect.tconstruct.break_block.ench: Mines up to hardness %s per level with %s
item.tconstruct.clear_item_frame.tooltip: Turns invisible when containing an item
item.tconstruct.clear_armor_stand.toolti: Turns invisible when any item is equipped
item.tconstruct.bone_armor_stand.tooltip: Has two arms for holding tools
item.tconstruct.dummy_tool_part.tooltip: Used to create casts, cannot be used to create tools.
item.tconstruct.repair_kit.tooltip: Use on a tool in the inventory to repair it the equivalent of %s ingots
item.tconstruct.fishing_rod.description: The Fishing Rod is a light ranged weapon, capable of short distance attacks without requiring ammo. It also can be used to fish if you're into that.
item.tconstruct.javelin.description: The Javelin is a hybrid melee/ranged weapon, ideal for both melee combat along with throwing for ranged damage. Just be careful after throwing as you will be without a weapon.
item.tconstruct.arrow.description: Arrows are your standard single-use projectile weapon, fired from both longbows and crossbows.
gui.tconstruct.plate_armor.description: Plate armor is a highly defensive armor set with limited ability slots.
gui.tconstruct.thrown_ammo.description: Shurikens and throwing axes are simple, disposable projectiles that can be thrown directly without any other tools. Shurikens fly a bit further, while axes deal more damage.
block.tconstruct.copper_gauge.tooltip: Interacting with the gauge shows the amount of fluid in the tank behind the gauge
block.tconstruct.obsidian_gauge.tooltip: Shows the type of fluid in the tank behind the gauge, and shows the amount when interacting.

death.attack.tconstruct.shock.item: %1$s was shocked by %3$s trying to hurt %2$s

gui.tconstruct.tank.bucket.fill_item.des: Slot will attempt to fill the item

material.tconstruct.wood.encyclopedia.am: Grants you twice as many arrows when crafting or part swapping, though lose half of the arrows when swapping from wood.
Movement penalty when using the shield is reduced by 10%.
Gives the projectile +0.5 accuracy, making arrows have perfect accuracy (even in inaccurate bows). Thrown weapons also get +25% velocity.
material.tconstruct.ice.encyclopedia.arm: Converts taken cold damage into durability shield.
material.tconstruct.ice.encyclopedia.amm: Freezes the target for 4 seconds (plus 4 seconds per level), causing slowness and damage over time.
material.tconstruct.cactus.flavor: A spiky shield spikes serious stabbers.
Adds +0.1 velocity per level at the cost of losing 1 health per level when firing arrows.
Adds +0.1 velocity per level and +0.5 power to thrown ammo at the cost of losing 1 health per level when launched.
Adds a 15% chance to deal 1-4 damage on counterattacks, or a 30% chance when blocking.
material.tconstruct.flint.encyclopedia.a: Allows casting potion on the ammo to tip it. Tipped ammo will apply a potion effect in addition to its damage.
material.tconstruct.bone.encyclopedia.ar: Has a 15% chance when hit for attackers receive 1 armor pierce per level for 4 seconds (or 8 seconds if blocking).
material.tconstruct.bone.encyclopedia.am: Causes the arrow to pierce through the first target it hits, while thrown projectiles disable shields.
material.tconstruct.bone.encyclopedia.ri: Increases unarmed damage by 0.5 and grants 1 armor pierce per level for 4 seconds.
material.tconstruct.necrotic_bone.encycl: Has a 15% chance when hit to heal over time 25% of damage received before armor.
Heals 5% per level of damage dealt from successful hits.
Heals 5% per level of damage dealt from unarmed critical hits.
Has a 25% chance of randomly teleporting attackers away, or a 50% chance when blocking.
Prevents the target from teleporting for 5 seconds per level, and can be fired at endermen.
Increases step height by 0.5 blocks per level.
material.tconstruct.leather.encyclopedia: Allows walking on powder snow and prevents uncomfortable damage from many blocks. When trimmed, prevents damage from thorns.
material.tconstruct.vine.encyclopedia.la: Tool has a 5% chance per sunlight level to resist damage, up to a 75% chance in full sunlight. Trim increases the chance to 6% per sunlight for a max of 90%.
material.tconstruct.iron.encyclopedia.ra: Causes firing arrows to attract nearby items to the holder.
material.tconstruct.iron.encyclopedia.ar: Reduces damage from projectiles by 8% per level, and grants 5% knockback resistance times the max level.
material.tconstruct.seared_stone.encyclo: Reduces damage from fire by 10% per level, and reduces fire burn time.
material.tconstruct.scorched_stone.encyc: Reduces damage from fire immune mobs by 5% per level, and reduces fire burn time.
Grants bonus protection at lower depth, +5% per 64 blocks below 64.
material.tconstruct.gold.encyclopedia.ar: Grants 10% protection per level against magic damage and reduces negative potion duration. Also makes piglins friendly.
material.tconstruct.slimewood.encycloped: Causes projectiles moving fast enough to bounce off blocks they hit up to 3 times.
material.tconstruct.slimeskin.encycloped: Gives a 5% chance per level of regenerating overslime each second.
material.tconstruct.venombone.flavor: Become the bane of your enemies
material.tconstruct.venombone.encycloped: Boosts melee damage when poisoned by 0.5 plus the level of poison.
Boosts drawspeed when poisoned by 0.05 plus 0.1 per level of poison.
Has a 15% chance when hit to venom the attacker making them take 200% magic damage for the next 5 to 10 seconds (or up to 15 seconds if blocking).
Applies venom to the target, causing them to take 200% magic damage for the next 5 to 10 seconds.
Boosts unarmed damage when poisoned by 0.5 plus the level of poison.
material.tconstruct.skyslime_vine.encycl: Grants +0.5 blocks jump height at first level, and +1 at second level. Increases the safe fall distance by 1 block per level.
material.tconstruct.skyslimeskin.flavor: Floating slimes stung by a bee.
material.tconstruct.skyslimeskin.encyclo: Reduces damage from airborne targets by 10%.
material.tconstruct.weeping_vine.encyclo: Grants up to +1.25 melee damage in hot biomes, but lose up to -1.25 melee damage in cold biomes.
Grants +0.75 power in hot biomes, but lose up to -0.75 power in cold biomes.
Grants up to +5% protection in hot biomes, but lose up to -5% protection in cold biomes.
Grants +40.5% speed on soul sand, plus an additional 10.5% added for each additional level. Reduces the slowdown from walking on soulsand.
material.tconstruct.twisting_vine.encycl: Grants +6 mining speed at the cost of losing 1 health when you put down the tool.
Grants +15% draw speed at the cost of losing 1 health when you put down the tool.
Increases movement speed by 10%, but deals 2 damage per level when unequipped.
Increases movement speed by 10% per level, but deals 2 damage per level when unequipped.
material.tconstruct.wool.encyclopedia.am: Multiplies the projectile damage by 0. Note damage may still be increased by bow power, and it may still aggravate mobs.
material.tconstruct.feather.encyclopedia: Has no special effect, but unlike other fletching choices lacks a downside.
Grants you half as many arrows when crafting or part swapping, though they might be gained back if swapping from leaves.
material.tconstruct.amethyst.flavor: Protects you from bad aim, provided you were aiming straight ahead
material.tconstruct.amethyst.encyclopedi: Grants +0.75 projectile damage per level, but restricts the angles the projectile may be thrown at. Stacks with amethyst bronze bows to further restrict angles.
material.tconstruct.prismarine.encyclope: Lets the ammo move freely underwater and grants +1 projectile damage per level to underwater targets. Fishing rods instead gain a level of lure.
Adds a 15% chance per level to deal 1-4 damage on counterattacks, or a 30% chance when blocking.
material.tconstruct.gunpowder.encycloped: Causes the arrow to explode at a radius of 1 plus 1 per level. Explosion damage is based on projectile power.
material.tconstruct.redstone.encyclopedi: Grants +10% velocity per level to arrows, and +20% velocity per level to thrown projectiles.
material.tconstruct.earthslime.encyclope: Causes the target to be knocked back in the opposite direction.
Gives a 5% chance per level of regenerating overslime each second.
material.tconstruct.skyslime.encyclopedi: Increases the knockback of the projectile.
Reduces gravity by 5% plus 10% per level per piece.
Grants +10% resistance while underwater, and increases swim speed by 5% per level based on the highest piece.
Grants 1 respiration and +10% swim speed per level.
material.tconstruct.nautilus.flavor: Master the cuisine of the sea
material.tconstruct.nautilus.encyclopedi: Grants immunity to Poison I, Hunger II, and Nausea I, increasing the max level of each when trimmed.
material.tconstruct.blaze.encyclopedia.a: Causes arrows to ignite, burning targets for 5 seconds per level.
material.tconstruct.blaze.encyclopedia.r: Gives +2 unarmed damage per level against burning targets.
material.tconstruct.ender_pearl.encyclop: Causes you to teleport to the location the projectile lands, destroying it. If it hits a monster, swaps places.
Has a 25% chance per piece of randomly teleporting attackers away. Higher levels send them further!
material.tconstruct.glass.encyclopedia.a: Decreases projectile damage by 0.75 per level, but gives it a tank. Upon impact, applies fluid effects from the fluid in the tank. Ammo breaks upon hitting a block when filled.
material.tconstruct.nahuatl.encyclopedia: Has a 25% chance per level (50% if blocking) of doing up to 5 damage over time.
material.tconstruct.obsidian.flavor: This is an obsidian part, if it was not it would not say "Obsidian."
material.tconstruct.obsidian.encyclopedi: Grants 10% protection per level against explosions, and reduces explosion knockback.
material.tconstruct.amethyst_bronze.ency: Grants +5% attack speed per level at the cost of +5% duration on negative effects and limiting taken knockback angles to 32, 16, 8, or 4 directions.
material.tconstruct.pig_iron.encyclopedi: Grants a 15% chance per level of eating the armor (consuming some durability) for 1 hunger per level at 0.6 saturation.
material.tconstruct.darkthread.encyclope: Increases looting level for monster drops. At second level, increases monster experience by 25%.
Reduces damage from melee attacks by 8% per level, and boosts movement speed when using items by 5% per max level.
material.tconstruct.kobold.flavor: Like discarded scales of a shimmering creature
Grants +5% attack speed, +10% use item speed, and +15% mining speed per level.
material.tconstruct.steel.encyclopedia.a: Grants +10% durability and +1 toughness per level.
material.tconstruct.magnetite.encycloped: Attracts mobs within a radius of 3 blocks per level towards the place the projectile hits.
Pulls nearby items, with radius and speed based on level.
Increases projectile damage by 0.5 per level.
material.tconstruct.dragon_scale.flavor: With this, even dragons will fear me!
material.tconstruct.dragon_scale.encyclo: Grants +8% resistance while airborne, and boosts attack damage by 5% per level based on the highest piece.
Increases projectile damage by 1 per level if launched while in mid air.
Prevents you from taking more damage than your max health - 2 in a single hit. Will not reduce the damage below 1.
Grants +10% critical hit damage and +2 safe fall distance.
material.tconstruct.shulker.encyclopedia: Grants +10% resistance while sneaking, but decreases attack damage by 10% per level while sneaking.
Allows collecting projectiles that hit entities instead of just blocks, making them infinitely reusable. Item will additionally not despawn.
Grants 3 inventory slots plus 3 per level.
material.tconstruct.manyullyn.encycloped: When at full health, take 1 less damage per level after armor and enchantments, down to a minimum of 1.
material.tconstruct.hepatizon.encycloped: Converts 50% of damage taken into a temporary flat damage reduction. Reduction lasts 5 seconds per level.
material.tconstruct.ichorskin.encycloped: Grants +5% movement speed, +2.5% attack speed, and +7.5% mining speed.
material.tconstruct.cinderslime.encyclop: Uses fuel to restore overslime, restoring 1 per second by level 4.
material.tconstruct.blazing_bone.encyclo: Has a 15% chance when hit to apply conductive to attackers making them take 200% fire damage for the next 5 to 10 seconds (or up to 15 seconds if blocking).
Applies conductive to the target, making them take 200% fire damage for the next 5 to 10 seconds.
Unarmed attacks apply conductive to the target, making them take 200% fire damage for the next 5 seconds plus up to 5 seconds per level.
material.tconstruct.blazewood.encycloped: Inflicts the attacker with 10 seconds of glowing, or 20 seconds when blocking.
Causes the target to glow for 10 seconds. If it hits a block, places a permanent light source at the cost of the projectile.
material.tconstruct.ichor.encyclopedia.a: Projectile will bounce upon hitting a block up to 1 time, plus 2 per level. Increases power by 0.5 per bounce per level before hitting the target.
material.tconstruct.ichor.encyclopedia.s: Grants +5% movement speed, +2.5% attack speed, and +7.5% mining speed.
material.tconstruct.magma.encyclopedia.a: Projectile will disappear half a second after launch, causing some traits to run in the air.
material.tconstruct.magma.encyclopedia.s: Reduces damage from fire by 10% per level, and reduces fire burn time.
material.tconstruct.glowstone.flavor: Brightest day, blackest night, no cave will escape my light!
material.tconstruct.glowstone.encycloped: Causes the target to glow for 10 seconds per level. If it hits a block, places a permanent light source at the cost of the projectile.
material.tconstruct.jadeite.encyclopedia: Grants up to +2.5 unarmed damage per level, with the damage increasing by +0.5 per level per hit over 5 consecutive hits.
material.tconstruct.jeweled_hide.encyclo: Increases drop chances from blocks, stacking with luck.
Increases the quality of loot from fishing, stacking with luck.
Increases max health by 1 heart. On shields, the heart is immediately restored, but you will take 1 heart of damage on unequip.
Increases fortune level for mined blocks. At second level, the looting level for monster drops.
material.tconstruct.ancient.flavor: They don't make them like they used to.
material.tconstruct.ancient.encyclopedia: Found on war picks, swashers, and battlesigns, plus from bartering. Each level grants +1 ability slot at the cost of -10% attack speed, -10% mining speed, and +10% gravity.
Available on melting pans, war picks, and from bartering. Each level grants +1 ability slot at the cost of -10% draw speed, and +10% gravity.

Obtained on plate armor in bastions, battle signs, melting pans, and from bartering. Each level grants +1 ability slot at the cost of +10% gravity, and -10% movement speed or -10% attack speed on shields.
material.tconstruct.knightmetal.flavor: Metal of the traveling slime, also found from armored Twilight creatures.
material.tconstruct.knightmetal.encyclop: Grants +0.4 damage per level per piece of armor worn by the target.
Grants +0.2 damage per level per piece of armor worn by the target (before velocity).
Increases protection by 4% per level per item in the attacker's arms.
Allows shooting fluid projectiles from your helmet by holding and releasing the helmet interact key. Takes about 2 seconds to reach full charge.
material.tconstruct.knightly.flavor: Shard of the traveling slime, sharper when unrefined.
material.tconstruct.knightly.encyclopedi: Grants +0.2 damage per level per piece of armor worn by the target (before velocity).
Grants +10% protection per level for each empty armor slot.
material.tconstruct.end_rod.encyclopedia: Projectile ignores gravity for the first second of its life.
Causes targets of unarmed attacks to levitate for 2 seconds, plus up to 5 more seconds per level.
material.tconstruct.knightslime.encyclop: Each level consumes 1 overslime (or 5 from broad mining) to grant +20% mining speed and +15% attack speed.
Consumes 1 overslime per level to grant +0.06 velocity and draw speed per level.
Consumes up to 2 overslime per level to reduce damage by 2.5% per overslime consumed (up to 5% per level).
material.tconstruct.enderslime_vine.ency: Grants a 7.5% chance to dodge incoming damage with a short cooldown. Chance is doubled for projectiles.
Grants a 7.5% chance per level to dodge incoming damage with a short cooldown. Chance is doubled for projectiles.
material.tconstruct.enderslimeskin.encyc: Has a 25% chance per piece of randomly teleporting attackers away.
material.tconstruct.enderslime.encyclope: Causes the target to be teleported randomly up to 16 blocks, or up to 24 blocks at level 2.
Grants a 7.5% chance per level to dodge incoming damage with a short cooldown. Chance is doubled for projectiles.
material.tconstruct.clay.encyclopedia.sl: Grants +1 armor and +5% knockback resistance per level.
material.tconstruct.honey.encyclopedia.s: Grants a 15% chance per level of eating the armor (consuming some durability) for 1 hunger per level at 0.1 saturation that also cures poison.
material.tconstruct.venom.encyclopedia.s: Grants 10% protection per level against magic damage and reduces the time of negative potion effects.
material.tconstruct.phantom.encyclopedia: Reduces gravity by 5% plus 10% per level per piece.
material.tconstruct.horn.encyclopedia.ri: Unarmed attacks deal +4 damage per level while sprinting.
Can be eaten (consuming some durability) to restore 1 hunger at 0.4 saturation and to remove a random effect.
Grants a 15% chance per level of eating the armor (consuming some durability) for 1 hunger per level at 0.4 saturation and to removes a random effect.
material.tconstruct.lead.encyclopedia.ar: Grants +15% knockback resistance, -10% movement speed, and +5% gravity per level.
Reduces damage from undead by 5% per level.
material.tconstruct.aluminum.encyclopedi: Grants +5% movement speed and +5% use item speed at the cost of 2.5% loss of protection.
material.tconstruct.treated_wood.encyclo: Increases both durability and repair efficiency by 15%.
material.tconstruct.ironwood.encyclopedi: When losing 1 durability, tool loses 1 extra durability (bypassing modifiers) to share durability with a random tool in the hotbar or offhand. Target gains 1 barkskin plus 1 per level.
When losing 1 durability, tool loses 1 extra durability (bypassing modifiers) to share durability with a random equipped armor. Target gains 1 barkskin plus 1 per level.
